body:
Hello there, another case: `Show less` is displayed when it shouldn't

Steps to reproduce :
- https://jsfiddle.net/8bhvmfa6/2/
- paste in the global search : `abide` -> no `show less` :+1:
- clear global search
- click on the first `show more`
- paste in the global search : `abide` -> `show less` :-1:
![](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/18403647/32664564-e8eb35f6-c631-11e7-8b3c-c4434f47d97e.gif)

With version 2.2.3
